text:
Alyssa: Ok team — final check for Dev Lounge next week. Who can confirm swag count and whether headsets arrive?
Ravi: Swag: 600 stickers, 300 shirts (S-2XL distribution), 150 keychains. Vendor said shirts ship Wed.
Megan: Can we bump shirts to 200? Last-minute signups. If yes, what's lead time?
Naomi (Vendor): @Megan we can do +50 shirts express but +$280 and ETA Fri 5pm. Need size breakdown by tomorrow.
Jon: Shipping address for booth: Redwood Inc — c/o Dev Lounge, 450 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105. Carrier: UPS Ground. Please put PO# RWI-9237 on label.
Priya: For lead routing: QR code -> Typeform -> HubSpot. Who's owning the Typeform mapping to hubspot fields?
Alyssa: @Priya I'll own Typeform. @Jon can you confirm connectors? We want utm_source=devlounge and model interest tag dropdown.
Jon: Connector is set. Use webhook key: prod/hooks/devlounge. I'll share in #marketing-private shortly.
Megan: Demo headsets: need 6 USB-C headsets + 2 backups. Naomi can you include on the order?
Naomi (Vendor): We can include 6 headsets; two extras are recommended. SKU: HD-UC-6. Bulk discount applies.
Alyssa: Budget check: swag + headsets + express shirts = $3.2k. Approve? :money_with_wings: 
Priya: Approve from sales. Can we prioritize lead capture for product trials? Add a checkbox 'Send trial link'.
Ravi: Volunteer schedule: need 2 per 2-hr slot, 10am-6pm. @Megan @Priya you both good for morning shift?
Megan: Yep 10-2
Priya: 12-4 is better for me, swap with @Ravi?
Ravi: I can do 10-2. I'll take 2-4 too if needed.
Alyssa: Speaking submission update: we got accepted for panel 'Serving LLMs at Scale' 11:30am. Speaker lineup: @Ravi, @Jon, and external partner Tara.
Jon: Slide deadline Mon EOD. Who's owning the deck? I'll stitch engineering bits.
Ravi: I'll do the narrative + benchmarks slide. Need throughput/cost graph from eng-runtime.
Alyssa: @Jon pls pull the perf graph and embed the latest p95 latency numbers.
Jon: pinging @eng-runtime for final plot. Also need a small fallback demo if live model connectivity fails — local demo image + pre-recorded video.
Megan: Can marketing create 2 roll-up banners? One for 'Redwood Inference' product and one for 'Free trial + headset demo'. I'll send assets.
Alyssa: Shipping bot just updated: tracking #1Z999AA10123456784 (shirts) expected Fri 6pm. :package: 
BoothVendorBot: Reminder — booth power requires 20A circuit. Please submit site power request by COB tomorrow.
Priya: Who's bringing the badge scanner? We can use the sales team scanner or rent on-site.
Megan: Let's borrow from sales. @Priya can you coordinate pick-up?
Priya: Yep I'll pick up from office Sat morning.
Ravi: Contingency: if shirts delayed, we can hand out sticker packs + QR code for delayed shirt shipping. Design okay?
Megan: Good backup. Create a short card template with 'Shirt shipping delayed? Fill this' + discount code.
Alyssa: Final checklist for tomorrow: size breakdown to Naomi, confirm connector keys, slide draft, banners assets, volunteer roster, power request. Tick when done.
Jon: I'll post the connector webhook key in #marketing-private and attach the perf graph.
Megan: Sending banner assets in an hour.
Priya: Badge scanner pickup added to calendar invite.
Naomi (Vendor): Received size breakdown, ordering shirts express now.
Alyssa: Awesome team, close loop on items by EOD. :rocket:
